Title: 497504-2026: France – Technical assistance – Technical assistance and external control in the context of repair / rehabilitation works on engineering structures (OA)
Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: The subject is technical assistance and external checking for repair/rehabilitation of ouvrages d'art (bridges/structures) and is therefore highly relevant in terms of content. Deduction for location France (outside DACH) and possible framework contract / multiple-structure character.
titel: Technical support and external control for repair and rehabilitation of engineering structures
kurzbeschreibung: Framework agreement of Métropole Rouen Normandie with CEREMA for technical support and external control in the context of construction, repair, and rehabilitation works on engineering structures and associated safety installations.
wettbewerb_art: Award of engineering and consulting services (framework agreement, negotiated procedure without prior call for competition)
gewinner_rolle: Engineering service provider for technical support and external control
gewinner_kontakt: Contract value framework agreement: 800000 EUR (max. 200000 EUR/year, term up to 4 years)
projektbeteiligte:
Metropole Rouen Normandie – client (public administration)
CEREMA – technical service provider for engineering structures (assistance technique et contrôle extérieur)
relevanzbewertung_begruendung:
- Framework agreement for technical assistance and external control, no specific individual bridge tendered
- Price as the sole award criterion (100 %), limited scope for high-end specialist services
- Quasi in-house award to CEREMA, effectively no market access for third parties
- Regional French engineering services without a clear need for an international specialist
checking_engineer_begruendung:
- External control services already explicitly awarded to CEREMA
- Quasi-regie relationship between Metropole Rouen and CEREMA, no need for an additional checking engineer
- Not in Germany, therefore not a classic checking engineer market for sbp
- Framework agreement without specific major projects or complex individual structures named
baukosten_erklaerung: No information on specific construction projects or construction costs; framework agreement for engineering services does not allow a reliable cost estimate.
naechste_schritte: No further steps recommended; the framework agreement is awarded as quasi in-house to CEREMA and leaves no room for additional structural or checking engineer services by sbp.
notes: Framework agreement (max. 200000 EUR/year, up to 4 years, total value 800000 EUR) for technical support and external control for construction and repair measures on engineering structures of Métropole Rouen Normandie. Price is the sole award criterion (100 %). The contract was awarded in a negotiated procedure without a call for competition, justified by quasi-regie with CEREMA. Not a classic architectural or structural design competition, but purely engineering/control services, already fully tied to CEREMA.
